ideas.pitch: A lightweight routing layer that dynamically selects between GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini, and smaller open weights based on prompt complexity to slash costs during high-volume API usage.
ideas.title: OpenAI API Cost and Latency Router
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages OpenAI as the primary sponsor and addresses an immediate, painful cost bottleneck that every developer and judge in the room faces when building AI apps.

ideas.pitch: A fast local daemon that intercepts terminal commands and git commits to automatically build a searchable graph of project decisions before engineers rotate off.
ideas.title: DevContext: Local Knowledge Capture for Handoffs
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the exact pattern of developer-tool winners that solve acute team lifecycle problems felt directly by engineering mentors and judges.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight execution harness that automatically rewrites and tests system prompts using an LLM-judge feedback loop until passing unit tests.
ideas.title: PromptSelfImprove: Self-Correcting LLM Loop
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly aligns with OpenAI's focus on advanced agentic reasoning workflows and demonstrates genuine algorithmic engineering within a tight 6-hour window.

ideas.pitch: An automated project scaffolding and context-injection CLI tool optimized specifically for AI code editors to prevent hallucinated imports and missing file references.

ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets developers using modern AI tooling in the room, making it instantly relatable and practical for hackathon judges evaluating workflow enhancements.
